removed.title: UFC signs Mike Perry after five-year split
removed.sourceMethod: Bing News indexed MMA Junkie original
summaryPoints: Perry (15-9 MMA, 7-8 UFC) has not competed in the UFC since April 2021.
The promotion parted ways after Perry lost back-to-back fights to Tim Means and Daniel Rodriguez.

kept.title: Mike Perry re-signs with UFC
summaryPoints: Mike Perry is returning to the UFC octagon.
“Platinum” officially announced that he’s re-signed with the UFC on Friday.
Perry hasn’t competed for the promotion since losing a unanimous decision to Daniel Rodriguez at UFC Vegas 23 in April 2021.
